highlights: Ugreen USB 3.0 to USB Type-C 1m 3A Cable (20882)
Extremely durable, USB cable with a USB Type-C connector. A cable made of strong plastic, which, thanks to USB 3.0 and supporting the current of 3 A , provides instant charging and data transfer.
Up to 40% faster than the standard accessory.
It is equipped with an intelligent management chip that adjusts the voltage to the device in question. So we don't have to worry about the risk of overcharging or short circuits .
Compatibility: devices with a USB Type C port
